articles.title: Most Americans blame Trump for high prices as his economic approval hits new low, AP-NORC poll shows - AP News
articles.description: A new AP-NORC poll finds that most Americans blame President Donald Trump for persistently high prices, while only about 2 in 10 approve of his handling of the cost of living. As midterm elections approach, the poll signals growing weariness over the Republic…
